messages.content: I want to settle the San Diego flights before we compare hotels. Put June 8 through 14 next to June 9 through 15 for all three of us, including the fare we would actually buy, bags, seat assignments, and how much vacation time each schedule gives us.

I found nonstop American itineraries for both six-night combinations. For June 8-14, the outbound leaves DFW at 7:35 p.m. and reaches SAN at 8:42 p.m.; the return leaves SAN at 3:40 p.m. and arrives at DFW at 8:42 p.m. Basic Economy is $996 total for three, while Main Cabin is $1,146. For June 9-15, the outbound leaves at 9:10 a.m. and arrives at 10:17 a.m.; the return leaves at 6:05 p.m. and reaches DFW at 11:07 p.m. Basic Economy is $1,224 total, and Main Cabin is $1,374.
What is included in Main Cabin versus Basic? I do not want the apparent low price if we then have to pay just to put the three of us together.

Both fares include one personal item and one full-size carry-on per traveler. Neither includes a checked bag; the first checked bag is $40 each way. Main Cabin lets you choose available standard seats at booking without an added fee and permits changes without a change fee, although a fare difference can apply. Basic Economy seat selection costs extra on these flights, currently $19-$36 per seat per segment, and its change restrictions are tighter.
Use Main Cabin in the comparison, with one checked suitcase for the family. Are there three standard seats together on every flight?

Yes. Each itinerary currently has a block of three standard seats together on both flights. With one shared checked bag round trip, June 8-14 comes to $1,226: $1,146 airfare plus $80 in bag fees. June 9-15 comes to $1,454: $1,374 airfare plus the same $80. The bag fee is normally paid during online check-in rather than in today's ticket charge.
So the later dates cost $228 more. Spell out what we gain for that, because the first day's late arrival bothered me.

The June 8 departure gets you to the hotel around 10:00 p.m. after collecting the bag and rental car, so Sunday contributes essentially no vacation time. You would have five full days Monday through Friday, plus Saturday morning and early afternoon before heading to SAN around 1:15 p.m. The June 9 departure should put you at the rental counter around 10:50 a.m. and at the coast near noon. It gives you most of Monday, five full days Tuesday through Saturday, and most of Sunday before an airport departure around 3:35 p.m. That is roughly nine more usable daytime hours for $228.
Does the Sunday return create any school issue? She would be home late, but Monday is still summer break.

It does not conflict with school based on these dates. The tradeoff is simply the late Sunday arrival: scheduled at 11:07 p.m., so you may not be home until around midnight. The earlier itinerary gets everyone home Saturday evening and leaves Sunday free.
The extra daytime is worth more to me than having Sunday at home. Before we buy, confirm that the totals include taxes and that we are not paying separately for those three seats.

Confirmed. The $1,374 ticket total for June 9-15 includes all airline taxes and mandatory booking charges for three Main Cabin round trips. The available standard three-seat blocks have no selection charge. The only planned flight-related amount outside today's ticket purchase is $80 for one checked bag in each direction, making the complete expected flight cost $1,454.
Which seats can you get? I would rather not be in the last few rows, and our daughter should be between us.

Row 18 has three adjacent standard seats available on both flights: 18A, 18B, and 18C outbound, then 18D, 18E, and 18F returning. They are regular Main Cabin seats, not exit-row or extra-legroom seats, and there is no added charge. I can place your daughter in the middle seat on each segment.
Book June 9 through 15 on those flights in Main Cabin. Use the row 18 seats you listed, with her in the middle. We will handle the one checked bag at check-in.

The three Main Cabin tickets are booked for Monday, June 9 through Sunday, June 15 under confirmation SD8K4P. The outbound nonstop leaves DFW at 9:10 a.m. and arrives at SAN at 10:17 a.m.; seats are 18A, 18B, and 18C. The return nonstop leaves SAN at 6:05 p.m. and arrives at DFW at 11:07 p.m.; seats are 18D, 18E, and 18F. Your daughter is in 18B outbound and 18E returning. The card was charged $1,374 today, including taxes. One checked bag each way remains payable at check-in for an expected $80, bringing the complete flight cost to $1,454. The June 8-14 itinerary was not booked, and the hotel search should now use June 9-15.
